scope: Finding teacher materials in Lite without browsing every page
changes: Server-side title search for curriculum, assignments and exported-document collections
Optional curriculum status filter with an explicit search and clear action
Session-memory filters retained when returning to a collection; no browser-storage text or per-keystroke requests
One extra row detects the next page without a separate count request or an empty final page
Inline retry retains submitted filters; aborted and stale responses cannot replace another screen

verification.mobileAccessibility: 360 px in light and dark themes: no horizontal overflow or axe violations in the content region
